title: IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEEET)
text: The 2026 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEEET)—the 12th edition in the series, featuring an expanded scope under a new IEEE-approved title—is themed “International Collaboration for Global Progress: Towards a Sustainable and Connected Future.” Jointly organized by NED University of Engineering & Technology (Pakistan) and the University of Peradeniya (Sri Lanka), the conference will take place on October 17–18, 2026, in Kandy, Sri Lanka, in a hybrid format offering both in-person and virtual participation.
venue: University of Peradeniya, Kandy, Sri Lanka
